title: Frappe ERPNext 15.87.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 15.87.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contain a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users without the Accounts role, or cross-site requests from authenticated users, to change the status of Period Closing Voucher jobs without proper permission checks. The vulnerability involves a request method that can be triggered cross-site, enabling unauthorized stopping of scheduled accounting jobs.
